title: Faleysiya C Probable NDE 9280
content: I left my classes, at that time I was studying at the university, and my job was in the evening; when I got off the bus, I had to walk a few blocks to my house and that's when a city bus ran over me. During my NDE, I was walking behind an old man with a hood who was carrying a lantern in his hand; we entered a dark tunnel, where hands came out from the sides of the tunnel, moaning and trying to touch me; the floor was slimy. Upon leaving the tunnel, the old man disappeared, and I was floating in a white light, similar to a cloudy day and in the background, there were the mountains of China, wrapped a little in mist (in my room I had a painting with Chinese mountains), but very far from me. My feeling was one of total anguish because I was completely alone and there was nowhere to go, I didn't understand what was happening. When I regained consciousness after the accident, I had no memory of what had happened and I got out of bed, I was alone, and I fell to the floor; I felt like my femur was sliding onto itself and was not holding me, then my mother told me that my leg was broken because they had run over me. Later, I began to feel dizzy while lying down, and they prescribed me medications and the dizziness stopped; apparently it happened every time I would think of the accident, which I could never remember until today; I think I blocked it. I didn't know anyone who claimed to know me, not even my 2-year-old daughter. I was never treated for those memory issues, nor did I mention them; over time I learned to know those people and I was identifying with this life. I only wanted to return to God after the accident, a profound longing led me to learn about Hare Krishna, gnosis, the Catholic charismatics, shamanism, the cyclopean method of internal activation of the pineal gland, yoga, among others. I wanted to be a yoga instructor and I didn't see the meaning of what I was studying at the university, but I didn't dare and I continued with the life I had before the accident, to this day; I never made a turn. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 11/18/2002 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death I was hit by a bus and my body flew 16 feet up, and then fell to the ground, breaking my right femur and leaving me unconscious How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely distressing Did you feel separated from your body? No. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal I am more lucid, I understand other influences that others do not grasp, even how the flow of life will react in a situation. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I floated in the mist Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. There was no time, which in my anguish was like an eternal suffering Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. The vision was the same, but sometimes from the corner of my eye I saw shadows, I was sure they were coming for me, to take me to the other side. Especially right after the accident. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. No changes Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes I went through the tunnel while guided by an old man, someone with a hood and a lantern in his hand. Upon leaving the tunnel, I floated into a white light, like on a cloudy day Did you see any beings in your experience? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Some unfamiliar and strange place. It was an infinite place, but there was nothing in it, everything was white, very similar to a cloudy day; at a great distance, very high, I could see the mountains of China, but only their peaks, because of the mist. What emotions did you feel during the experience? Anguish Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? No Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I no longer profess religion, I am an apostate, and I feel free to experience rituals for spiritual purposes What is your religion now? Do not know I do not profess any religion, but I believe in a higher force Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I always believed that we were truly guided as we passed into the other world, and I saw the old man with the hood guiding me. I had a painting of Chinese mountains in front of my bed and they appeared during my NDE; I floated in distressing nothingness and now I think that the nothingness was a representation of the loneliness and disconnection that I have felt all my life, that is a constant. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Since the NDE, I think there is a part of me which I cannot access directly, to which I owe my life, and I try to figure out what it thinks about what I do or I ask it to share its opinion. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I heard a voice I could not identify In the tunnel, I heard moaning. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists. For me, it was clear that life continues after you leave the physical body; I was really there. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes After the accident, I was certain that the only thing that mattered in life was love. But I was thinking that, I didn't feel it. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life Now I cannot live without meditations, spiritual exercises or reflections of the spirit; they are part of who I am now. Before, this dimension did not exist for me. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes It is such an unlikely experience that words cannot evoke what you want to convey. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience.e experience This experience was so real, more real than everyday life, so that long after the NDE, I believed that I was dead and that what I was experiencing was not real. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes A little clairaudience Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? The emptiness is very significant, and I still can't reconcile with it, it still scares me a lot. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I shared my experience months after the accident and people would fall silent and change the subject; it was very lonely, until today. My niece and daughter were influenced by my spiritual vision of the world and now they carry out activities related to the spiritual Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I did not understand what I was doing with the family to which I returned, I was sure that I had died, and that another soul lived in me, another being. I was totally confused and no one could help me because they did not understand. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I believe that I am not linked to experiences at the level of “consciousness”, which may or may not be in a body, in this or another dimension, and that is what happened to me during the NDE; my consciousness moved without my body and when I returned, I had no explanation. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes When I see car accidents, I panic, and I have to stop to drive away. Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Thank you for allowing me to share Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? I don’t know.

arrival.other_being_detail: An old man with a hood carrying a lantern guided her through the tunnel; he disappeared upon leaving the tunnel.

environment.environment_other_detail: A dark tunnel with slimy floor; hands came out from the sides, moaning and trying to touch her. After the tunnel: an infinite white space like a cloudy day; distant mist-wrapped Chinese mountain peaks.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Hit by a city bus; body flew about 16 feet; unconscious; right femur broken.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Hooded old man with lantern guiding her; hands emerging from tunnel walls; floating alone in white mist-like emptiness with distant Chinese mountains.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Guided through a dark tunnel first; then the guide disappeared and she floated alone in an infinite white space with distant mountains.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Hands emerging from the tunnel walls, moaning and trying to touch her; slimy floor; distant Chinese mountains resembling a painting in her room; post-accident memory disruption/identity confusion (did not recognize family, including 2-year-old daughter).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was floating in a white light, similar to a cloudy day and in the background, there were the mountains of China, wrapped a little in mist.”
